description: Practical operator resources for catering business owners: licensing, pricing, contracts, software, and certifications.
tagline: The operator resource for running a catering business.
image_alt: Institute of Catering — Practical operator resources.

authors.name: Institute of Catering Editorial
authors.bio: Our editorial team consists of experienced catering operators and business consultants who research and verify the practical realities of running a catering business.

editorial.testing_policy: All guides are researched and verified against active regulations, licensing laws, and standard catering operations. We consult directly with experienced operators.
editorial.monetization: We make money through affiliate commissions when you purchase catering software or certifications through our links. Sponsored links are always clearly disclosed.
editorial.corrections: If we make an error regarding a regulation or process, we update the piece immediately and add a dated correction note to the bottom of the article.
